starter_questions: Can I try the fictional offline quote comparison?
What purchase brief and must-have requirements do you need?
Why did this option lead, and what could change the comparison?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll compare purchase options, costs and risks so you can review a recommendation. Try the fictional offline quote sample, or describe your purchase and add any supporting documents. You'll get a comparison with assumptions and missing terms; I won't contact suppliers or place orders.

sample.title: Simulation: GPU workstation quotes
sample.description: Compare three fictional suppliers and their 36-month known costs entirely offline. This sample prepares a review packet; communication and ordering are not performed.
sample.expected_output: After the offline sample completes, a simulated comparison showing Cedar’s lower known cost over 36 months, the required reviews and Delta’s missing quote.

values.inputs.payload.item_description: Compare five GPU workstations from three fictional suppliers for sensitive internal datasets.

real.introduction: Describe what you want to purchase and the outcome it must achieve. Add must-have requirements and any budget or supporting quotes; I'll prepare a comparison and identify what still needs human review.

fields.label: What do you want to purchase?
fields.description: Describe the item or service, who it is for, and the outcome you need.

fields.label: Supporting documents folder
fields.description: Optional quotes, requirements, research links, spreadsheets, PDFs, or images for this purchase.

fields.label: Budget
fields.description: Your maximum purchase or landed-cost budget.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The delivery, use, property, or travel location that affects availability and cost.

fields.label: Priorities
fields.description: List the factors the comparison should favor, one per line.

fields.label: Constraints
fields.description: Review the must-have requirements and change any values that do not apply.

fields.label: Cost assumptions
fields.description: Review the lifecycle-cost, utilization, labor, downtime, tax, and residual-value assumptions.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Where the completed purchasing packet should be copied.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explicit preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.
